title: Works ok, but it is too small
text:
Works ok, but it is too small. The idea behind this mat is good - it is absorbant and good to put your freshly washed dishes on.

The mat quality is nice. We tried it out, as we don't have a dishwasher. Our kitchen is very small and we have very little counter space. I thought the mat might be great.

Well, it could be, if it was a lot larger. Even with our very small counter space, this mat is too small! It won't hold a lot of dishes or pans.
If it is just one person who doesn't like to cook, this might be great. The water absorbing part did work well. But there just isn't enough room for our use. I went back to what I was using before, a large bath towel to sit everything in.

Good idea, but only covers a little space, so mostly good for singles.
